Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities,

to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of

IS: 5548- 1970 




Indian Standard 

SPECIFICATION FOR 
LUBRICATING NIPPLE ADAPTORS 



( Reaffirmed 2001 )

1. Scope — Specifies the overall dimensions and thread sizes of the following two types of lubricating 
nipple adaptors: 

a) Straight adaptors, and 

b) Angle adaptors. 

2. Dimensions 

2.-1 Straight Adaptors

AH dimensions in millimetres. 

Designation — A straight lubricating nipple adaptor of nominal size MIO x I shall be designated as: 

Straight Adaptor MlOx I IS : 5548- 1970. 

2.2 Angle Adaptors 




Ail dimensions in millimetres. 

Designation— An angle lubricating nipple adaptor of nominal size MlOx I shall be designated as* 

Angle Adaptor MlOx I IS : 5548- 1970.

IS : 5548 - 1970 

3. Materia! -- The body of the adaptors shall be manufactured from free-cutting brass conforming to 
IS : 319-196?.* or from brass or bronze having hardness value In the range of 110 to 190 HV 5 (see 
IS : 2866-19651). Alternatively, the body shall be manufactured from steel conforming to the property 
class 4 8 of IS : 1367-1967t 

4. Workmanship and Finish 

4.1 The adaptors shall be finished smooth and shall be free from burrs, cracks and other manufacturing 
defects. Threads shall be cleanly formed and free from imperfections. 

4.2 Adaptors manufactured from steel shall be plated with zinc ( see IS : 1 573- 1960§ ) or cadmium (see 
IS : I572-I960|l ). 

5. Marking - To be marked with the nominal size and the manufacturer's name or trade-mark. 

6. Packing -- The adaptors shall be packed in accordance with the best prevalent trade practice or as 
specified by the purchaser. 

7. Sampling —Unless otherwise agreed to between the purchaser and the supplier, the sampling plan as 
given in Appendix A shall be followed. 

8. ISI Certification Marking — Details available with the Indian Standards institution, New Delhi, 



APPENDIX A 
( Cause 7 ) 

SCALE OF SAMPLING AND CRITERIA FOR CONFORMITY 

A- 1. Scale of Sampling 

A-I.l Lot — In any consignment all the lubricating nipple adaptors of the same size and type and manu- 
factured from the same material under essentially similar conditions shall constitute a lot. 

A-1.2 For ascertaining the conformity of the lot to the requirements of this specification tests shall be 
carried out for each lot separately. The number of lubricating nipple adaptors to be selected at random 
from each lot shall be as given below. To ensure the randomness of selection, IS : 4905-1968^1 shall be 
followed:

A-2. Number of Tests and Criteria for Conformity 

A-2.1 The lubricating nipple adaptors selected according to A-1.2 shall be examined for dimensions, and 
workmanship and finish. Any lubricating nipple adaptor failing to satisfy the requirements for any one, or 
more, of the characteristics shall be declared defective. 

A-2.2 The lot shall be declared conforming to the requirements of this specification if the number of 
lubricating nipple adaptors found defective is less than or equal to the corresponding number given 
inA-1.2.
